name: append-file
description: Append content to the end of an existing file. The file must already exist — create it with write-file first (appending to a missing path is an error so a typo'd path surfaces instead of silently creating an empty file). Use this instead of shell '>>' redirection.

path.description: Path to the file to append to (absolute or relative). Must exist.

content.description: Content to append to the end of the file.
